चोक्कण्ण कवि composed for king Śarabhojī:
 Kumārasambhavacampū. Burnell 157^b.

चोक्कनाथ of last century:
 Dhāturatnāvalī gr. Burnell 42^b.
 Śabdakaumudī. Burnell 42^a.

चोक्कनाथ son of Tippa, wrote for Ṣajirāja (beginning
of the 18th century):
 Kāntimatīpariṇaya nāṭaka. Burnell 168^a.

रामभद्र दीक्षित called also चोक्कनाथ son of Yajñarāma
Dīkṣita, contemporary of Nīlakaṇṭhādhvarin, Kauṇḍa
Jyautiṣika, Bālakṛṣṇa, of last century:
 Jānakīpariṇaya nāṭaka.
 Patañjalicarita kāvya.

चोक्कनाथ son of Nārāyaṇa, guru and father-in-law of
Rāmabhadra Dīkṣita:
 Dhāturatnāvalī and Śabdakaumudī.

चोक्कनाथ son of Nārāyaṇa, pupil of Nīlakaṇṭha, client
of Veṅkaṭeśa, son of Yajñanārāyaṇa:
 Mahābhāṣyaratnāvalī.
